definitions.explanation: A passive or defensive posture in which one reacts to others' actions rather than taking initiative.
The grammatical construction where the subject receives the action rather than performing it.
A technique in judo and other martial arts for falling safely to avoid injury.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はいつも{受|う}け{身|み}だ。
{受|う}け{身|み}の{姿勢|しせい}ではなく、{自分|じぶん}から{行動|こうどう}しよう。
examples.english: Don't be passive — take action yourself.

examples.japanese: {受|う}け{身|み}でいると、チャンスを{逃|のが}してしまう。
examples.english: If you remain passive, you'll miss your chance.

examples.japanese: この{文|ぶん}は{受|う}け{身|み}で{書|か}かれている。
examples.english: This sentence is written in the passive voice.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}の{受|う}け{身|み}には「{迷惑|めいわく}の{受|う}け{身|み}」がある。
examples.english: Japanese passive has a 'suffering passive' form.

examples.japanese: {受|う}け{身|み}の{作|つく}り{方|かた}を{練習|れんしゅう}しましょう。
examples.english: Let's practice how to form the passive voice.

examples.japanese: {柔道|じゅうどう}ではまず{受|う}け{身|み}を{習|なら}う。
examples.english: In judo, you first learn breakfalls.

examples.japanese: {受|う}け{身|み}がうまくできないと、{怪我|けが}をする。
examples.english: If you can't do breakfalls well, you'll get hurt.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろ{受|う}け{身|み}と{横|よこ}{受|う}け{身|み}を{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し{練習|れんしゅう}した。
examples.english: I practiced back breakfalls and side breakfalls repeatedly.

notes:
A compound of {受|う}ける (to receive) and {身|み} (body, self). Literally "receiving body" — the posture of receiving rather than initiating.

USAGE:
The most common everyday usage is sense 1 (passive attitude). For language learners, sense 2 (passive voice) appears frequently in textbooks. Sense 3 (breakfall) is specific to martial arts but well known in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受|う}け{身|み}の{姿勢|しせい} — passive attitude/stance
- {受|う}け{身|み}{的|てき} — passive (as a modifier)
- {受|う}け{身|み}を{取|と}る — to take a breakfall (martial arts)
- {迷惑|めいわく}の{受|う}け{身|み} — suffering passive (grammar)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {消極的|しょうきょくてき} — passive, negative; similar to sense 1 but broader
- {能動|のうどう} — active; the opposite in grammar ({能動態|のうどうたい} = active voice)
- {積極的|せっきょくてき} — proactive; the attitudinal opposite
